home_day:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: production background for the Japanese HTML visual novel game 水煙前線, Chapter 1, Hajime's home, DAY variant.
Input image 1 is the existing background to remaster; preserve the same room identity, object layout, camera framing and single-room apartment. Output one landscape 16:9 image at 1920x1080 or larger, full image edge-to-edge.
Primary request: redraw this room with the game's current high-resolution fine pixel-art / anime background aesthetic: deliberate very fine pixel clusters, crisp coherent architectural edges, beautifully controlled warm/cool colors and natural cinematic daylight, restrained texture. It must retain a subtle pixel-art finish compatible with detailed anime character sprites, never noisy low-resolution dithering or photorealism.
Scene invariants: left wooden bookcase, framed abstract wall art, air conditioner high on left-center wall, gray bed on left-center, large centered balcony window with dark blue curtains and modest Japanese city view, small kitchenette at right rear, dark compact refrigerator, entry door at far right, wooden study desk at lower right, low wooden coffee table at lower center, wood floor and simple neutral rug. Keep furniture positions and room scale. No luxury redesign. No new hooks or equipment.
Composition: eye-level wide room view; clear depth, consistent single-point perspective. Lower 25 percent and center remain calm to accommodate dialogue UI and characters. No visually aggressive highlights behind the central portrait. Detailed but readable objects; modest book spines without readable lettering. The three principal light sources are window daylight, a soft warm kitchen under-cabinet lamp, and a subtle desk lamp. Direction of daylight from window is coherent; avoid arbitrary flare, blur, haze, sharpening halos, or grain.
Constraints: no people, no faces, no hookah or smoking equipment, no text, no logos, no watermark. Keep window and all furniture unchanged in design. No duplicated furniture, impossible wall geometry, wobbly perspective or malformed kitchen utensils.
home_night:
Use case: lighting-weather
Asset type: Chapter 1 visual-novel home background NIGHT variant, exact match to the new day background.
Input image 1 is the approved new daytime room: EDIT TARGET and geometry/style reference. Input image 2 is the OLD nighttime room: reference only for nighttime mood and established location, not its lower image quality.
Change ONLY lighting and the outdoor sky/city light state in image 1. Keep every wall, beam, window frame, furniture shape, book, plant, cushion, kitchen utensil, mug, notebook and desk exactly in its position in image 1. Same camera, same crop, same perspective, same room scale. Output one landscape 16:9 image, ideally 1920x1080 or larger.
Preserve the same refined fine pixel-art/anime background rendering as image 1: clean confident edges and purposeful restrained texture, compatible with detailed high-resolution anime sprites. No blur, grain, noisy dithering or photorealism.
Lighting: peaceful late evening in a modest Japanese one-room apartment. Outside window is deep navy blue with small warm lights in the SAME buildings, no sunset or daytime clouds. Remove ALL sunshine rectangles and sunlit floor patches from image 1. Room lit by bedside lamp, kitchen under-cabinet lamp and desk lamp with subdued warm amber pools and soft cool blue ambient light from window. Nighttime mood visible but furniture remains readable; moderate contrast so dialogue text in the lower 25% reads comfortably. No fog, no glow bloom, no added objects.
Constraints: no people, no faces, no hookah or smoking equipment, no text, no logos, no watermark. Do not rearrange or redesign room. No perspective distortion, duplicated furniture or impossible lamp shadows. Books may have abstract small marks, never readable lettering.
home_overcast_day:
Use case: lighting-weather
Asset type: Chapter 1 visual novel home background OVERCAST DAY, used for both cloudy and rainy days.
Input image is the approved new sunny room, EDIT TARGET. Change ONLY lighting and the sky state outside the window. Keep exact architecture, camera framing, window position, furniture, plants, bookcase contents, all small objects, bedding, kitchen and lamps.
Replace the blue sky outside with soft dense cool-gray overcast clouds; preserve the same outdoor buildings. Remove ALL direct sunshine rectangles on wall, bed, and floor. Soft diffuse neutral daylight with a restrained cool blue-gray cast, balanced with small warm bedside lamp, kitchen under-cabinet lamp and desk lamp pools. This is DAYTIME, readable and airy, not dark night. No hard sun shadows. Same refined fine pixel-art/anime illustration style, clean edges and deliberate restrained textures as the input, no grain or blur.
Do NOT paint rain or drops on the glass: game renders rain animation independently and the same background is used on cloudy days. No rain streaks, puddles or fog. Keep the lower quarter calm for dialogue UI.
Output single wide 16:9 production background, 1920x1080 or larger if available. No people, no text, no logos, no watermark, no hookah or smoking equipment; no additions or rearrangement. Exact room continuity.
